_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: An explicitly selected worktree stays selected. {{REPO}} is a git repository with a worktree {{WORKTREE}}; an init script sets localStorage "shelley_selected_cwd" to {{REPO}} before the page's own scripts on every load (already in place: steps must not set it). "The dialog" is the dialog named "Select Directory". "The directory control" on this phone-sized screen is the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory"; to reach it, click the button named exactly "More options" first unless ".chat-overflow-popover" is already visible. Call "saved" reports the first message the page sends: "none" before it, then "ok cwd=<the conversation's saved working directory> draft=<whether it is still a draft>". To "send P and expect cwd C": fill [data-testid="message-input"] with P; call "saved", which must return exactly "none"; click [data-testid="send-button"]; then call "saved" until it returns exactly "ok cwd=C draft=false". To "check and send in C": the directory control's text should contain C; press Escape; then send "echo: new conversation directory" and expect cwd C. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Click the directory control. 3. Fill the dialog's ".directory-picker-input" with "{{WORKTREE}}/" (the worktree path followed by a slash). 4. The dialog's ".directory-picker-current-path" should have exactly the text {{WORKTREE}}. 5. Click the dialog's button named exactly "Select". 6. Check and send in {{WORKTREE}}.
